title: Plugin manifest invalid
message: The manifest of {plugin_id} is invalid: {reason}.
basic_text: This plugin's description file has a mistake, so Rastai can't load it.
fix_text: Ask the plugin's author for a fixed version.

title: Plugin id reserved or already installed
message: The plugin id {plugin_id} is reserved or already installed.
basic_text: A plugin with this name is already installed, or the name is reserved.
fix_text: Remove the installed plugin first, or give yours another id.

title: Plugin command id outside the plugin's namespace or in a reserved area
message: The command id {command_id} is outside the namespace of plugin {plugin_id}, or in a reserved area.
basic_text: This plugin tries to add a command under a name it isn't allowed to use.
fix_text: The plugin's author must name the command under the plugin's own id.

title: Plugin command type missing from types.json
message: The command {command_id} names the type {type_name}, which types.json doesn't define.
basic_text: This plugin is incomplete: a command refers to a definition it doesn't ship.
fix_text: Ask the plugin's author for a fixed version.

title: Plugin contributes to an extension point it doesn't require
message: The plugin contributes to {extension_point}, which it doesn't require.
basic_text: This plugin adds a feature it didn't declare.
fix_text: Ask the plugin's author for a fixed version.

title: Manifest declares a UI id that the UI didn't register
message: The manifest declares {ui_id}, but the plugin's UI didn't register it.
basic_text: A panel or view this plugin promised didn't appear.
fix_text: Ask the plugin's author for a fixed version.

title: The UI registered an id the manifest doesn't declare
message: The plugin's UI registered {ui_id}, which the manifest doesn't declare.
basic_text: This plugin tried to add a panel or view it didn't declare.
fix_text: Ask the plugin's author for a fixed version.

title: Python register() names differ from the manifest's ids
message: The names the plugin's Python register() returns differ from the manifest's ids: {difference}.
basic_text: This plugin's parts don't agree about what it provides.
fix_text: Ask the plugin's author for a fixed version.

title: Plugin's engines range excludes this plugin API
message: {plugin_id} needs plugin API {range}; this version of Rastai provides {api_version}.
basic_text: This plugin was made for a different version of Rastai.
fix_text: Update the plugin, or the app, so the two match.

title: Required capability not provided
message: {plugin_id} requires the capability {capability}, which isn't provided.
basic_text: This plugin needs a feature this version of Rastai doesn't have.
fix_text: Update Rastai, or use a version of the plugin that doesn't need it.

title: Experimental API used without the flag
message: {plugin_id} uses the experimental API {api_name}, but experimental APIs are off.
basic_text: This plugin uses an experimental feature that is turned off.
fix_text: Turn on plugins.experimental_apis if you trust the plugin.

title: Plugin command not available yet
message: {command_id} isn't available in this version of Rastai yet.
basic_text: This feature is planned but not built yet in this version of Rastai.
fix_text: Nothing to fix on your side: the feature arrives in a later version.

title: User namespaces unavailable: a third-party plugin module can't be isolated
message: User namespaces are unavailable, so the plugin module of {plugin_id}, which has no network permission, can't be isolated; it is refused.
basic_text: Your system can't sandbox this plugin, so Rastai won't run it.
fix_text: Install Rastai's AppArmor profile, or grant the plugin network access.

title: Trust prompt declined
message: The trust prompt for {plugin_id} was declined; nothing was installed.
basic_text: You chose not to install this plugin.

title: Plugin archive changed since the trust prompt
message: The plugin archive {path} changed since its trust prompt; the install stopped.
basic_text: The plugin file changed after you approved it, so Rastai stopped.
fix_text: Get the plugin again from its source and review its permissions again.

title: Iframe called a command outside the plugin's granted scopes
message: The plugin's panel called {command_id}, which needs the scope {scope} that the plugin wasn't granted.
basic_text: This plugin tried to do something you didn't allow.
fix_text: Grant the permission in the plugin's settings if you trust it.

title: User namespaces unavailable: a first-party plugin module runs without network isolation
message: User namespaces are unavailable; the plugin module of {plugin_id} runs without network isolation.
basic_text: Your system can't fully sandbox this built-in plugin, so it runs with less isolation.
fix_text: Install Rastai's AppArmor profile to restore isolation.

title: Plugin dependency missing or unsatisfiable
message: The dependency {dependency} of {plugin_id} is missing or can't be satisfied.
basic_text: This plugin needs something that isn't installed.
fix_text: Install the dependency, or a version of the plugin that works without it.

title: Plugin lockfile conflicts with the base environment
message: The lockfile of {plugin_id} conflicts with the base environment: {reason}.
basic_text: This plugin needs Python packages that clash with Rastai's own.
fix_text: Ask the plugin's author for a version that matches this Rastai.

title: Plugin install interrupted
message: Installing {plugin_id} was interrupted.
basic_text: The plugin install stopped before it finished.
fix_text: Install the plugin again.

title: Plugin data from a newer version of this plugin; opened read-only
message: This data is from version {version} of {plugin_id}, newer than the installed one; it opens read-only.
basic_text: This data was made by a newer version of the plugin. You can look at it but not change it.
fix_text: Update the plugin.

title: Plugin module crashed
message: The plugin module of {plugin_id} crashed.
basic_text: Part of this plugin stopped unexpectedly.
fix_text: Try again; if it keeps happening, report it to the plugin's author.

title: Plugin module didn't answer in time
message: The plugin module of {plugin_id} didn't answer within {timeout_seconds} seconds.
basic_text: This plugin took too long to respond.
fix_text: Try again; if it keeps happening, report it to the plugin's author.

title: Plugin module crashed repeatedly; plugin disabled
message: The plugin module of {plugin_id} crashed repeatedly, so the plugin was disabled.
basic_text: This plugin kept crashing, so Rastai turned it off.
fix_text: Update the plugin or report the problem to its author, then turn it back on.

title: Malformed bridge message
message: The plugin's panel sent a malformed bridge message: {reason}.
basic_text: This plugin's panel sent something Rastai couldn't understand.
fix_text: Report it to the plugin's author.

title: Too many bridge calls in flight
message: The plugin's panel has more than {limit} bridge calls in flight.
basic_text: This plugin's panel is sending requests too fast.
fix_text: Report it to the plugin's author.

title: Bridge message too large
message: A bridge message from the plugin's panel is {size_bytes} bytes; the limit is {limit_bytes}.
basic_text: This plugin's panel sent a message that is too large.
fix_text: Report it to the plugin's author.

title: Iframe didn't initialize in time
message: The panel of {plugin_id} didn't initialize within {timeout_seconds} seconds.
basic_text: This plugin's panel didn't start.
fix_text: Reload the panel; if it keeps happening, report it to the plugin's author.

title: Plugin UI threw while loading or registering
message: The UI of {plugin_id} threw while loading or registering: {reason}.
basic_text: This plugin's panel failed to load.
fix_text: Report it to the plugin's author.

title: Unknown template
message: Unknown plugin template {template_name}.
basic_text: There is no plugin template with that name.
fix_text: Pick one of the listed templates.

title: Target folder for plugin new is not empty
message: The target folder {path} for plugin new is not empty.
basic_text: The folder for the new plugin already has files in it.
fix_text: Pick an empty or new folder.

title: Generated plugin types are out of date
message: The generated plugin types are out of date.
basic_text: The plugin's generated code no longer matches its types.json.
fix_text: Run rastai plugin codegen.

title: types.json is invalid
message: types.json is invalid: {reason}.
basic_text: The plugin's type definitions file has a mistake.
fix_text: Fix types.json at the place shown.
